lessons.title: 5. INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
lessons.description: Insert a new course into the courses table with title 'AI Web Apps', category 'Web', price 0.0.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: insert the course (id 5, 'AI Web Apps', 'Web', 0.0) then select it back
SELECT * FROM courses WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code:
INSERT INTO courses (id, title, category, price) VALUES (5, 'AI Web Apps', 'Web', 0.0);
SELECT * FROM courses WHERE id = 5;

tests.name: test_insert_course
tests.test_code: assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0][1] == 'AI Web Apps'

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — INSERT — 'creates one or more new rows in an existing table'

learning_objectives: Add rows with INSERT INTO ... VALUES
Modify existing rows with UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE
Remove rows with DELETE FROM ... WHERE
